# Test fixtures

Empty as of Week 1. Starting Week 2, each rule family (wage floor,
overtime, FICA, federal withholding, Illinois withholding) gets its
worked examples copied from the agency publication into this directory
as JSON: inputs, expected output, and the source page cited in a
comment. Never generate a fixture's expected value from this
repository's own implementation -- it must come from an agency-published
example or, for the anomaly rules, from the labeled synthetic dataset's
ground truth.
